title: Ecolab Delivers Strong Performance and Impact
summary: 2025 Growth & Impact Report shows how Ecolab is built for growth in the AI era The world is entering a period of historic growth, complexity and opportunity. As artificial intelligence reshapes industries and demand for energy, food and water accelerates, how companies grow next will matter as much as how fast they grow. In a rapidly changing world, Ecolab remains constant. Today, the company released its 2025 Growth & Impact Report highlighting how Ecolab continues to deliver strong business performance while deepening its impact on customers and communities in the areas that matter most. Technologies like AI promise extraordinary progress, but they cannot scale without mastering water. “Water is the foundation of life and business.
